331:                      to show the binary file contents.",
332:                     Yellow.paint("[bat warning]"),
333:                     input.description.summary(),

335:             } else if self.config.style_components.grid() {
336:                 self.print_horizontal_line(handle, Self::grid_junction_top())?;

341:         let mode = Self::content_mode_label(self.content_type);
342: 
343:         let description = &input.description;
344:         let metadata = &input.metadata;

346:         // We use this iterator to have a deterministic order for
347:         // header components. HashSet has arbitrary order, but Vec is ordered.
348:         let header_components: Vec<StyleComponent> = [
349:             (
350:                 StyleComponent::HeaderFilename,
351:                 self.config.style_components.header_filename(),
352:             ),

356:             ),
